subject: Trading
title: Trailing Stops
description: A quick win: understand Trailing Stops.

hook.text: Your stock is up 20%. You want to protect those profits but also let the trend run. A trailing stop does both.

buildup.text: A trailing stop moves up with the price but never moves down. It follows like a ratchet, locking in gains.

discovery.text: Set a trail of 5%. If the stock goes from $100 to $120, your stop rises from $95 to $114 automatically.

twist.text: Too tight a trail gets stopped out by normal volatility. Too wide gives back too much profit. Balance is key.

climax.text: Trailing stops solve the 'when to sell' problem. The market tells you—when momentum fades enough to trigger it.

punchline.text: Let profits run. Let the trail catch them.

quiz.question: How does a trailing stop work?
options: It moves down with the price
It follows price upward and locks in gains but never moves down
It stays at a fixed price always
